title: 1992 AMC 8 Problem 20
statement: Which pattern of identical squares could not be folded along the lines shown to form a cube?

solutions.text:
Each of the five patterns has \(6\) squares. Folding patterns (A), (B), (C), and (E) wraps the squares neatly onto the six faces of a cube.

For pattern (D), any attempt to fold forces two of the squares to land on the same face, so they overlap and no cube can be formed.

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: A cube has \(6\) faces, so each pattern has \(6\) squares; try folding each one up in your mind
Track where each square lands as the pattern folds; a pattern fails when two squares would cover the same face
